jobs.name: Daily brief
jobs.prompt: Summarise what I should focus on today based on memory and open tasks. One short paragraph.

jobs.name: Top tasks reminder
jobs.prompt: Using memory/MEMORY.md and memory/logs/{{DATE}}.md (today's log), list my top 3–5 tasks or priorities for today. If you have access to Tududi or any task list, prefer tasks from there. Reply with a short bullet list only, no preamble. If nothing is clearly due today, say so in one line.

jobs.name: Triggered by webhook
jobs.prompt: Append to memory: Webhook was triggered at this time.
